why.weeksMode.noregret: Balanced: weeks plus a penalty for each skill's exposure in the worst case (Fast AI, 2030).
why.weeksMode.safest: Safest: favours the skills AI is least likely to take over, even if slower.
why.weeksClosed: Skills AI has taken over are closed roads; routes go around them.
why.expFormula: Exposure and demand move in a straight line from their 2026 value to the 2030 value of the chosen scenario.

why.takenRule: A skill is taken over when exposure is at least {thr}% this year and demand is falling.

stress.title: How sturdy is this plan?
stress.axes: Each square is one possible future: AI arrives slowly, moderately or fast · AI can do each skill a bit less or a bit more than our estimate · you study your planned hours, 75% or 50% of them. Hover a square for details.
stress.fail.open: AI takes over {skill} by {year} before you get there
stress.fail.ready: needs {weeks} weeks, only {available} before your deadline
stress.fail.worth: demand for the job falls by {year}
stress.why.open: AI takes over {skill} before you reach it
stress.why.ready: not ready before your deadline at a slower study pace
stress.fixHours: Study {h} h a week: works in {n} of {total}
stress.method: A stress test, not a probability of being hired. Three checks in every future: the road stays open, you are ready by your deadline (or 2030), and the job is still in demand. Exposure range from where ILO WP140 and the Anthropic Economic Index disagree; slow AI is our assumption (half of Moderate). Catalogue values are sample data.
sheet.esco.kicker: Any job in ESCO, the EU's official list
esco.modelExposure: Our model's estimate (average of this job's skills)
esco.iloNote: The headline figure is the ILO's 2025 estimate (Working Paper 140) for the whole group "{group}" ({gradient}).
esco.noIlo: The ILO has no estimate for this job's group.
esco.method: Skills and jobs: ESCO v1.2.1 (European Commission, CC BY 4.0). A skill in your profile counts fully; a closely related one counts 40%. Tap "I have this" to confirm a skill: it is saved to your profile and counts fully. Routes on the map cover our curated catalogue only.
esco.studies: Other studies are for the closest US job, "{onet}": GPTs are GPTs (Eloundou et al., 2024) {gpts}, Anthropic Economic Index {aei}.
esco.tasksSrc: Tasks from O*NET "{title}" ({match}), U.S. Department of Labor, CC BY 4.0, linked through the official ESCO to O*NET crosswalk. Ratings by human annotators in Eloundou et al. (2024), "GPTs are GPTs", Science. A rating is about saving time, not replacing the person.
esco.my.head: Pay and jobs in Malaysia for all {group}. These figures cover the whole group, not this one job.
esco.my.note: Source: DOSM Salaries & Wages Survey, by MASCO major group (CC BY 4.0).
esco.criticalNote: Its group "{title}" is on Malaysia's Critical Occupations List 2024/2025 (TalentCorp and ILMIA): employers report a shortage.
